observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: on a wooden stage with a painted forest backdrop in a theater or hall
observation.dancers: around 14-16 mixed group of young men and women
observation.formation_and_space: group moves across the stage, dispersing into lines, forming lines of women facing forward, or couples stepping centrally
observation.posture: upright or bent forward from the waist with knees softly bent in a low athletic stance
observation.footwork: fast rhythmic stepping, stamping on the beat, high knee lifts and jumps with weight shifting rapidly
observation.arms_and_hands: arms swing dynamically, wave, or hold sticks/batons; women clasp hands near hips or raise arms overhead
observation.hips_and_torso: bouncing and undulating torso movements matching the rhythm of the footwork
observation.partnering: none as contact partnering; group coordination and synchronized ensemble work
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent high leaps, deep knee bends, squatting low to the floor, and quick turns
observation.costume_and_props: women wear black sleeveless tops with yellow fringe skirts, beaded necklaces, and headbands; men wear leopard-print vests, fringe skirts, headbands with feathers; props include wooden sticks/batons
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement on the ground and detailed weight distribution due to quick camera cuts and low resolution

signature_moments.what: dancers run onto the stage with energetic high-stepping and swinging sticks
solo dancer in center performs rapid high kicks and stamping while group kneels and claps in unison
line of women rapidly stamping feet and waving sticks with vigorous upper body movement
male dancers leaping powerfully with high knee extensions and swinging batons
